title: Download scoped designed salesman order evidence pages as PDF
description: Users download their current salesman-output design as Chinese PDF using the same finite fields/date/customer/salesman/original-currency filters and stable page. Add PDF endpoint to existing dynamic controller and narrow Infrastructure exporter reusing existing PDFsharp/SimHeiPdfFontResolver. Independently validate/reauthorize fresh identity/menu/customer scope and bounded preview without requiring prior preview or accepting client rows. Preserve column order, currency labels/known signed decimals and explicit unknown amounts/profit, current page/date/filter/source caps and assigned approved-order basis even hidden columns. Paginate long/wide tables with repeated headings and empty-evidence output; never sum currencies, fabricate profit, claim actual shipments/receipts, or count salesman/currency rows as orders. Missing font/render failure gives explicit error without corrupt file. Designer sends current values and retains selection/date/filter/page state on invalid/denied/network/font failures; existing detail Excel and report/home consumers remain compatible. Development only: use the existing salesman-output menu, fresh current-user SalespersonDataScopeService customer scope and approved nondeleted SalesOrders; employee identity is an order attribute, never a broader permission boundary. Existing OperationLogMiddleware records HTTP audit; all endpoints recheck identity/menu/scope and reject invalid/revoked/source-overflow requests without data/file. No client identity/scope/rows/amounts as authority, expanded ERP permissions, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, business table writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, production SQL/real database execution, credentials/secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible actions, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated modules and uncommitted work. Run focused in-memory service/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test; unavailable external database/browser acceptance is explicitly environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: PDF independently validates current fields/date/filters/page and rechecks menu/identity/fresh scope and source caps through the existing preview, returning no file on failure.

Infrastructure Chinese PDF preserves selected-column and row/column pagination with signed original-currency values, explicit unknown/empty evidence and page/filter/source context; font/render failure is explicit.
Designer uses current request values and preserves state on failure; PDF/API/UI and Excel compatibility regressions plus safe Release build/test pass.
